chunks: I was certain I'll be given my account.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the certainty of facing divine accountability?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as highlighting the psychological state of the disbelievers who, despite their denial of the unseen, possess an innate certainty (yaqin) of the Day of Judgment. This conviction serves as a prelude to the specific reckoning they will face, emphasizing that their accountability is not merely a possibility but an inevitable reality. The verse underscores the transition from general belief in resurrection to the specific accounting of one's deeds.
